packages.title: Origin
packages.shortDescription: Native app for Stremio addons on LG webOS TVs. Unofficial.

manifest.title: Origin
manifest.appDescription: Your own Stremio account and addons on your LG TV, in English or Arabic: artwork and full-screen trailers, the best stream in one press, styled subtitles, clean search. Unofficial.
notes: A new player bar: Three groups of icons: the picture on the left (upscale, picture size), the film in the middle (back, play, forward, with your seek step written on them), sound and subtitles on the right.
OpenSubtitles Pro, built in: More subtitles and none of the spam. Choose in Settings: with AI translations, made by people only, or off.
Brightness and See in the dark, stronger: Dark scenes are opened up properly now, and both work on Google TV too, with Clear voice and Even volume.
Reduce for old TVs: Google TV: a lighter app for slow devices. On by itself where memory is short, or a switch in Settings, Appearance.
